3967-4336-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Kobolds of Kher Keep is starting in your graveyard.
3967-4336-5006-8170.description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Kobolds of Kher Keep spell. Then, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

240-5434-5470-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
240-5434-5470-8227.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Loot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

2527-4076-4279-4549-7192.easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc that has toughness 2 or more.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2527-4076-4279-4549-7192.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Burakos, adding one mana of any color.
Burakos triggers, causing it and other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the other Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc, targeting Burakos
When the creature dies, the creature's undying ability and Grave Venerations trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Burakos and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing Burakos, targeting the other creature.
When Burakos dies, its undying ability and Grave Venerations trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning Burakos from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the other creature and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

512-2085-5724.easyPrerequisites: Sage of the Maze and Kelpie Guide do not have summoning sickness.
512-2085-5724.description:
Activate Sage of the Maze by tapping it, adding {W}{W}
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Kelpie Guide and Sage of the Maze, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

2292-4381-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2292-4381-4694-7306.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, scrying 1.
Repeat from step 1.

731-2822.easyPrerequisites:
Your commander is on the battlefield and doesn't have summoning sickness.
Corrupted Conscience is attached to your commander.
731-2822.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander has power 10 or greater.
An opponent cannot block your commander.
731-2822.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using your commander, which will get at least ten poison counters due to its infect. This will cause the opponent to lose the game due to having ten or more poison counters.
Kediss triggers, causing your commander to give each other opponent at least ten poison counters due to its infect. This will cause each opponent to lose the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

396-728-2033-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
396-728-2033-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Blessed Sanctuary triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1676-3899-6972.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3025-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat.

443-2738-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Magus of the Bridge, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1379-5226-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
1379-5226-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost, causing it to enter as an artifact land creature due to Encroaching Mycosynth and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing that creature.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 2 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
Resolve all activated abilities from Lithatog.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

4613-5310-5434-5477-5627.easyPrerequisites: There is a land card in your library.
4613-5310-5434-5477-5627.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Bloodghast that is untapped and that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4613-5310-5434-5477-5627.description:
Activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, searching your library for a land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Repeat using the Plant instead until no lands are in your library.

147-4050-7335.easyPrerequisites: There is a valid target for Pain 101 on the battlefield.
147-4050-7335.description:
Cast Pain 101 by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Pain 101, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Pain 101.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2092-4050-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {1} at most due to Agatha, creating a token copy of another artifact creature you control with haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the artifact token, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4373-7297.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4373-7297.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ghalta and Mavren as attackers.
Ghalta and Mavren triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

632-2034-3621-4460-5129.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-2034-3621-4460-5129.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

413-2366-5929-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
413-2366-5929-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Blasting Station and Haru trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Haru trigger, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 one additional time.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 6.
Repeat from step 5.

232-1235-4285-4823.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Increasing Vengeance by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Timeless Witness.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Timeless Witness with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Timeless Witness tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Increasing Vengeance from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-5010-5946-7028.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with different powers.
4050-5010-5946-7028.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {B}.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {1}.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

38-1829-5220-6900.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Vindictive Vampire trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

224-1671-1772-3875.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Coralhelm and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1020-2866-5645-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

232-1283-5553-5626.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
232-1283-5553-5626.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Greedy Freebooter and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token and causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Priest of Urabrask from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Priest of Urabrask and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{R}, enabled by Chromatic Orrery.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

224-1659-5627.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
224-1659-5627.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Seed the Land and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Repeat.

1020-1117-3689-5705-5866.description:
Cast Myr Retriever for its emerge cost by paying {0} and sacrificing Workshop Assistant.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability and Workshop Assistant trigger.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Workshop Assistant trigger, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate an Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Cast Junk Diver for its emerge cost by paying {1} and sacrificing Myr Retriever.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability and Myr Retriever trigger.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Myr Retriever trigger, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Cast Workshop Assistant for its emerge cost by paying {0} and sacrificing Junk Diver.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability and Junk Diver trigger.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Junk Diver trigger, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat.

678-4192-5231-5659-5753.easyPrerequisites: "Lhurgoyf" chosen with Ashes of the Fallen.
678-4192-5231-5659-5753.description:
Discard Circling Vultures from your hand using its static ability.
Because Circling Vultures is a Lhurgoyf due to Ashes of the Fallen, Disa the Restless's first ability triggers, putting Circling Vultures from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Circling Vultures, adding {R}.
When Circling Vultures dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Circling Vultures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Thermopod ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Ghyrson Starn.

428-3769-5096-5361.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal exactly 2 damage to an opponent.
Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
428-3769-5096-5361.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Blim.
Blim triggers, giving an opponent control of Protection of the Hekma.
Deal 2 damage to that opponent by any method, reduced to 1 due to Protection of the Hekma.
Ghyrson Starn and Auton Soldier trigger.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Auton Soldier triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 6.

2440-2511-3490.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2440-2511-3490.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Servo on the battlefield.
Repeat.
2440-2511-3490.notes: If there is at least one other Servo on the battlefield to start the combo, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

413-2281-2732.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Saffi dies, Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers, exiling Saffi from your graveyard.
Resolve the Saffi ability.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Prowling Geistcatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Prowling Geistcatcher enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Prowling Geistcatcher trigger, returning Saffi from exile to the battlefield.
When Saffi enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 4, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
